Hi Suzanne / Jonas — quick heads up: when Suzanne forwarded the invite it landed in my calendar as “Thu, Jun 24 09:00” with no timezone attached, and my client (Outlook on desktop) treated it as local time (AEST). That means the invite shows up to me as 9:00 AM AEST which is midnight in London — not the intended 09:00 BST.

We often see this when an .ics is stripped of TZ blocks or when forwarding via some mail clients (they sometimes convert the DTSTART to a floating time). Can we either:

  1) resend the invite with explicit timezone blocks for Europe/London, or
  2) move the demo to a later slot that is more APAC-friendly (e.g., 16:00 BST / 01:00 AEST is still rough), or
  3) create a separate APAC-friendly session?

I can attend if we pick a later time — happy to be flexible.

— Arun

arun@asia-payments.com

Thanks for flagging this, Arun — exactly the issue. Short explanation and plan: 

What happened
- The original invite was created in Europe/London (BST) and included the appropriate VTIMEZONE block. Some mail clients (or forwarding flows) will drop the VTIMEZONE or convert DTSTART into a "floating" time (no TZ attached). When that happens the recipient's calendar treats the time as local.

Immediate next steps
1) I'll reissue the calendar invite from my account and add Arun and any APAC participants directly (not forwarded) so the event includes an explicit Europe/London TZ.
2) I'll also include a second optional slot that is APAC-friendly — proposed: Thu 24 Jun 17:30 BST / Fri 25 Jun 02:30 AEST (I know that's not ideal) and Thu 24 Jun 13:00 BST / Fri 25 Jun 00:00 AEST as an alternative. Please confirm a preference and I will send a new invite and update the HubSpot meeting link.
3) Marissa, Diego — can one of you resend the agenda PDF to Arun as a direct attachment (some clients prefer PDFs to embedded Drive links).

Apologies for the churn — these TZ / forwarded-ICS issues keep causing overlap for cross-region demos. If this is a recurring problem for FinTrac we can set up two short regional sessions next week (EU + APAC) and record the EU session for US viewers.

Action items

- Suzanne: if you want the original slot to stand for EU participants only, I can mark it as "Europe session" and create a separate APAC invite.
- Marissa: please resend agenda to Arun.
